title: U.S. WHO Membership Exit Legal Map
question: When did United States WHO membership end, and what remained unresolved about the depositary record, assessments, IHR and Pandemic Agreement?
bluf: HHS, State and CDC said U.S. WHO membership ended January 22, 2026 after the notice period. The depositary record, current-year assessment proviso, IHR amendments and Pandemic Agreement remain distinct legal objects and unresolved states.
